title: Body cues and possible emotions (psychoeducation)
disclaimer: Body cues overlap across emotions and medical conditions. Use this as a starting hypothesis, not a diagnosis. If sensations are new, severe, or worrisome, consider medical evaluation.
references_note: Grounded in interoception research and common clinical psychoeducation about autonomic arousal (e.g., muscle tension, breathing changes) associated with stress responses.
